title: 🐱 Playful & Cuddly Cats Ready for Adoption in Wichita - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Wichita has some very special cats looking for safe, loving homes. If you’ve been thinking about adding a furry friend to your family, these sweet kitties are ready to meet you.
Bert Breed: Russian Blue / Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Male Color: Gray/Blue Adoption Fee: $125 Shelter: Wichita Animal Action League (WAAL)
Phone: (316) 895-9225 About Bert:
Bert is a cuddle bug who loves to be held and will purr in your arms . When he’s not snuggling, he enjoys playtime and toys. He gets along well with children, other cats, and even dogs , making him a great fit for many homes.
Bert and his brother Ernie were sadly dumped in the WAAL parking lot , but they are now safe and being cared for. If you’re looking for a pair of kittens, Bert would love for you to meet his brother too.
👉 Meet Bert and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Ernie Breed: Domestic Shorthair Age: Baby (kitten) Gender: Male Color: Gray/Blue Adoption Fee: $125 Shelter: Wichita Animal Action League (WAAL)
Phone: (316) 895-9225 About Ernie:
Ernie is the kitty who wants to keep you company during everything—cooking, cleaning, or watching TV. He’s friendly and likes everyone he meets, including other cats and dogs .
Like his brother Bert, Ernie was found after being dumped at the WAAL parking lot , and now he’s ready for a forever home where he’ll never be left again. Consider adopting Ernie with Bert if you’d love a fun, bonded pair.
